findings.namedBuyers: Two verified historical event contacts: Kyle Tomlin, booth-space contact; Carlos Baudett, sponsorship contact. Both are commercially relevant referral routes to the event team; neither is established as a 2027 hotel buyer or accommodation contracting authority.
findings.futureEdition: Exact published venue-calendar window: September 25–30, 2027, at Metro Toronto Convention Centre, North Building, Toronto, Ontario, Canada. These are event-window dates explicitly displayed by the venue, not publication dates. No organizer-published 2027 attendee start/end dates were located. The six-day window must not be represented as six delegate nights; whether it includes setup or teardown remains unverified.
findings.venueCommitments: MTCC publicly lists its North Building for September 25–30, 2027. This establishes a published venue listing, not inspection of a signed agreement or hotel commitments.
findings.accommodationSourcing: 2027 hotel sourcing status is unconfirmed. For the historical October 5–7, 2026 edition, ICSC required registration before hotel booking and identified onPeak as its official hotel provider. That historical pathway does not establish a 2027 appointment, open hotel procurement, available inventory or incumbent hotels.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Ask Kyle Tomlin to confirm the 2027 attendee opening/closing dates versus the MTCC September 25–30 event window and introduce the 2027 housing decision-maker. Then verify whether onPeak is appointed and whether additional hotels are being considered. Do not quote a six-night delegate block from the venue window.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: The 2027 edition is publicly listed by the venue, but hotel participation and procurement accessibility are not established.
